_doc: Goods the SRD 5.2 describes in prose rather than as items, in its own words (#243). Edited by hand; tools/build_srd.py writes each good's description from it and stops if a quote is not verbatim on its page (a dnd5e.content24 page, 'Journal / Page'), a table row does not read `row cell` there, or an actor or page does not exist. lead: one sentence of ours ahead of the quotes, where goods quoting the same text need telling apart. quotes: SRD sentences, one paragraph each. row/cell/label: a table cell shown as 'label: cell'. actor: a dnd5e.actors24 stat block to link. see: a page to link instead of prose, for goods the SRD only prices.
